title: quadlet: configure mount source dependencies
body:
Add [Quadlet] SetMountsDependency to select RequiresMountsFor, WantsMountsFor, or no generated dependency for user mount source paths. Keep Requires as the default to preserve existing behavior and retain the required dependency on Podman's container storage directory.

Document the available values and the systemd version requirement for WantsMountsFor. Add Quadlet integration fixtures covering Wants, Requires, None, and invalid values.

Fixes: #29946
